name: images_animate_svg
description: Adds CSS/JS animation to an SVG. Pass `svgCreationIdentifier` (from `images_to_svg` or `images_generate_svg`) plus a `prompt` saying what should move; with no SVG it generates an animated one from the prompt alone. `presets` add cursor/click interactions. Billed by tokens after generation. A static vector is `images_generate_svg`. Then `creations_show`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

presets.description: Interactions to add: eye-tracking, head-tilt, spotlight-follow, magnetic-elements, repel-elements, hover-reveal, color-shift, hover-bounce, scale-pop, click-animate, toggle-states, confetti-burst, ripple-effect, parallax-layers, tilt-3d, drag-elements, breath-effect.

prompt.description: What should move and how ("the wheels spin, the smoke drifts up"). Required when no SVG is given.

svgCreationIdentifier.description: SVG creation to animate. Omit to generate one from the prompt.
